approximations: Names, IDs, page, pixel, audience and destination are synthetic; settings are current snapshots, not historical truth. Case status overrides are simulated conditions, not inferred from zero delivery.
Reach is modeled from daily impressions with repeat exposure across days; frequency is impressions divided by modeled window reach, not measured unique reach.
Pixel event stats mirror reported actions; PageView uses link clicks as a synthetic proxy.
All breakdown dimensions use equal deterministic shares with integer remainder allocation; they are not observed performance.
Withheld creatives use explicit unavailable-image disclosure cards; supplied assets retain packet checksums and are staged separately.
